rows.grounds: acc. sg. nt. compound; refers to the level up to the kalā tattva in the cosmological hierarchy (a08 deśādhvan).
indeclinable numeral adverb; koṭi (ten million) + dhā (fold/way), expressing measure (a08 world-measure).
sandhi-split: tasmāt + māyā; abl. sg. pron. + nom. sg. fem. noun; marks transition from preceding level to māyā (a08).
compound with numeral; likely daśa-koṭi-dhā (ten times ten millionfold) or similar multiplicative measure; exact form uncertain from tokenization (a08 world-measure).
nom. sg. masc.; name of the tattva/deity Īśvara in the 36-tattva hierarchy (a08 compendium/union).
nom. sg. or numeral compound; śata-koṭi (hundred times ten million) used as a measure (a08 world-measure).
sandhi-split: syāt + tasmāt + koṭi-sahasra-dhā; optative of as + abl. pron. + multiplicative measure (thousand times ten millionfold); expresses further scaling (a08 world-measure).
